_description: Strings that should NOT be redacted even if detected as PII. Use this to preserve operationally useful tokens like internal hostnames, region codes, or service identifiers. 'literals' is matched case-insensitively as exact strings. 'regex_patterns' uses Python re.search semantics. WARNING: do not allowlist anything that could be PII (emails, SSNs, names) — this list overrides redaction.
